targets.method: a sys.excepthook / QApplication.notify() wrapper installed for the gate run counts any exception that escapes to it
targets.scenario: full offscreen Qt gate suite (G-QT-GUI) execution, including the concurrency fault suite

targets.method: race-suite harness fires a cancel then injects a late-arriving async result and asserts the UI/state was not overwritten by the stale response
targets.scenario: cancel an in-flight fetch, then deliver its (late) result after a newer request has already completed

targets.method: fault-injection harness asserts no synthetic/fabricated price or indicator value is ever substituted for a failed network response
targets.scenario: each case of the offline fault matrix (timeout, DNS failure, connection refused, malformed payload, partial payload)

targets.method: the persisted config/settings file is read and validated as well-formed before and after each fault-injection case
targets.scenario: each case of the offline fault matrix run with a concurrent config read/write in flight

targets.method: run the full product unittest suite (python -m unittest discover -s tests) 20 times consecutively; failure_rate = failed_runs / 20
targets.scenario: 20 consecutive clean-process runs of the full core test suite with no code changes between runs

targets.method: run the full offscreen Qt test suite (QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen) 10 times consecutively; failure_rate = failed_runs / 10
targets.scenario: 10 consecutive offscreen-Qt process runs of the full Qt/GUI test suite with no code changes between runs

targets.method: count consecutive full gate-pipeline runs (G-LOOP..G-RELEASE) with zero failing gates, recorded in state/gate-runs.jsonl
targets.scenario: release-candidate gate pipeline executed end-to-end once per candidate commit

targets.method: fault-injection harness pass_rate = cases_passed / total_required_fault_cases across the documented offline fault matrix
targets.scenario: the full required offline fault matrix (timeout, DNS, refused, malformed, partial) run once per gate execution

targets.method: wall-clock time from close/quit request (with in-flight async tasks) to full process exit; rate = runs completing within deadline_ms / total runs
targets.scenario: application quit triggered while an individual-stock or screener analysis task is still in flight, covering the abort() -> quit() -> bounded wait() shutdown sequence in NETWORK_RESILIENCE.md

targets.method: static/manual audit counts critical surfaces (result views, HTML manual, CSV/clipboard export) that render the non-advice disclaimer versus the total number of critical surfaces
targets.scenario: every result view plus the generated HTML manual plus CSV/clipboard export, once per release candidate
